title: Revert "Qt: Have all DisplayFilterEdits have bookmarks"
description: The DisplayFilterEdit widgets does not look good on macOS after this changes. Revert until a good UI solution is found.

notes.body:
ℹ️ This merge request has more than one commit. Please squash any trivial ones:
  ~~~
  1edd2e10 Revert "Qt: Have all DisplayFilterEdits have bookmarks"
39b94e6b Revert "Qt: DisplayFilterEdit touch-ups"
5f5e1737 Revert "Qt: DisplayFilterEdit bookmark button background"
  ~~~

Fair enough. After this !16440 does some preliminary work allowing us to use the DisplayFilterCombo in multiple places, and that might look better on macOS (and also have the drop down.) It would also be possible to substitute it only in certain places, because I suspect the search frame will be the toughest.

I haven't found an easy fix, and currently I don't have time to work on finding a good solution. I don't want us to release a new feature if it makes UI look bad.

I was thinking about using a dummy widget instead of the QComboBox to get correct border StyleSheet, but I'm not sure if this is better than using DisplayFilterCombo in all places.

The search frame also have other issues. Like pressing <enter> after a valid display filter will bring up the auto-complete pop-up in addition to doing a search, and the next <enter> will close the auto-complete pop-up without doing a search.
